name: risk.account_outflow

list.description: Read native account-outflow risk observations for explicit warning instants.

parameters.name: warning-from
parameters.description: Inclusive warning start instant: ISO8601 timestamp with explicit offset, at most millisecond precision.

parameters.name: warning-to
parameters.description: Inclusive warning end instant: ISO8601 timestamp with explicit offset, at most millisecond precision.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Exact native instId selector sent as entitys array; repeat for OR within entity, AND with bank. This changes native acquisition scope.

parameters.name: bank-id
parameters.description: Exact native bankId selector sent as bankIds array; repeat for OR within bank, AND with entity. This changes native acquisition scope.

purpose: Inspect native EXPECTED_BAL_NOT_ENOUGH warnings without changing notification or risk state.

fields.name: warningTime
fields.meaning: Native service warning time; preserved independently of account-local warningLocalTime and capture time.

fields.name: instId
fields.meaning: Native entity identifier; no ownership inference.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account alias; not warning observation identity.

fields.name: currencyPairs
fields.meaning: Native currency context, retained without deriving currency codes or units.

fields.name: currentBal
fields.meaning: Native current balance, without display scaling or recalculation.

fields.name: daytimeBuffer
fields.meaning: Native warning buffer, not a locally computed classification.

fields.name: warningLocalTime
fields.meaning: Native account-local warning time; never reinterpreted as an absolute instant.

fields.name: updateTime
fields.meaning: Native update time, separate from warning time and capture time.

identity_description: Native monitorNo identifies one warning observation in the exact bounded source scope.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant and EXPECTED_BAL_NOT_ENOUGH warning reason. Only the verified account-outflow query is used.
Warning bounds require explicit offsets and normalize to UTC milliseconds. Native warningTime, warningLocalTime, timezone and updateTime remain unchanged.
Width 1000 is qualified for complete acquisition, not a backend maximum. Native row totals govern offset paging; short-page recovery is not enabled.

Full native rows, unknown fields, nested values, nulls, blanks, zeros, precision and response order remain unchanged. No amount scaling, risk classification, account-capacity join, notification change or Duckdog import.
Native entitys and bankIds arrays define the saved source scope; returned rows must match supplied exact values. No ownership resolution or offline widening.
Native aliasNames can silently broaden an unknown alias to all rows; that selector is excluded. Currency selector mapping remains unqualified and is excluded.
Native warningTime uses the qualified service clock +08:00 for bound validation. Account-local warningLocalTime is preserved separately, without output conversion.

A native total below observed arrivals is an explicit SDK contradiction failure, never an empty success or a corrected count. Failed, incomplete and successful-empty refreshes preserve the prior saved capture.
